title: TraceX
desc: TraceX maps distributed server topologies and analyzes root causes during outages. It provides live dependency graphs, automated causal diagnosis, and real-time telemetry flows to locate infrastructure bottlenecks.

title: EBAT
desc: EBAT is a landing page for tactical surveillance and FPV drones built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4. It includes dark mode styling, responsive layouts, and interactive component specs for aerospace systems.

title: Yanegi
desc: Yanegi is a real-time map of local community activities. It uses the browser Geolocation API and Next.js to display nearby sports, open mics, and gatherings without algorithmic feeds.

title: PaperBuddy
desc: PaperBuddy is an educational management platform for schools. It centralizes attendance, fee collection, exam schedules, and bus transport tracking into a synchronized dashboard.

title: Paw
desc: Paw is a pet adoption web application. Users browse available animals, read pet care guides, and message rescue shelters directly.

title: SadakSaathi
desc: SadakSaathi is a road safety and navigation application. It provides route condition alerts, user-reported road hazards, and one-tap emergency assistance contacts.

title: DocDesign
desc: DocDesign converts static document scans into editable templates. Users modify text, update layouts, and export the edited files to PDF and document formats.

title: Github Analyzer
desc: GitHub Profile Analyzer visualizes public GitHub account activity. It aggregates commit history, top programming languages, and repository stats into interactive charts.

title: AI Health
desc: AI Health analyzes food photos to calculate macronutrient breakdowns. Users authenticate with Google OAuth to query Gemini 2.0 Flash using their personal API quota.

title: Zyricon: Full-Stack GenAI Workspace
desc: A full-stack workspace combining Google OAuth 2.0, PostgreSQL Row Level Security, database RPC procedures, and Supabase Edge Functions with Google Gemini REST endpoints.

title: ORBIT Shipping Services
desc: ORBIT Shipping Services is a freight management web platform with cargo tracking, quote calculation, and animated transitions built with GSAP and Framer Motion.

title: Moviely
desc: Moviely is a movie discovery web application built with Next.js and TypeScript to search releases, filter genres, and maintain watchlists.

title: ECHO
desc: ECHO is an Android music player built with Kotlin and Jetpack Media3 for local audio playback and playlist management.

title: UI UX Designs
desc: A collection of design systems, wireframes, and interactive prototypes built in Figma for web and mobile products.

title: YouTube Video Downloader Extension
desc: A Chrome extension that extracts video and audio streams from active tabs through an Express backend service.
